$comment: What a bot or Mini App can know about a Telegram user, by how it arrives. Names are checked against data/bot-api/catalog.json and data/mini-apps/webapp-catalog.json by tests/test_user_data.py. Rules: references/user-data.md. Read 2026-11-24 (Bot API 10.5).

sensitivity.low: public profile data the user already shows to every bot
sensitivity.medium: personal but not identifying on its own outside Telegram, or tied to a chat
sensitivity.high: identifies the person outside Telegram or locates them: phone, exact location, documents, email, address

automatic.what: arrives with every update or Mini App launch, no prompt

items.name: User.id
items.use: the account key; store it, never show it

items.name: User.first_name
items.use: address the user; refresh on each update, it changes

items.name: User.last_name
items.use: rarely needed; do not store unless a feature shows it

items.name: User.username
items.use: links and mentions; optional and changeable, never a key

items.name: User.language_code
items.use: the interface language

items.name: User.is_premium
items.use: Premium-only features such as custom emoji; never a price signal

items.name: User.added_to_attachment_menu
items.use: attachment menu flows

items.name: WebAppUser.photo_url
items.use: the avatar in the app; load it, do not copy it to your storage

items.name: WebAppUser.allows_write_to_pm
items.use: whether the bot may message the user; else requestWriteAccess

items.name: WebAppInitData.chat_type
items.use: where the app was opened

items.name: WebAppInitData.chat
items.use: the group or channel the app was opened from (attachment menu)

items.name: WebAppInitData.receiver
items.use: the chat partner in a private-chat launch; data about someone who did not open the app

items.name: WebAppInitData.start_param
items.use: the deep-link payload: a route, never personal data

items.name: WebAppInitData.auth_date
items.use: freshness of the signature

items.name: ChatJoinRequest.bio
items.use: moderating a join request in a chat the bot administers

items.name: ChatJoinRequest.user_chat_id
items.use: message the requester for up to 5 minutes while the request is pending

api.what: readable by the bot about a user it already knows, limited by that user's privacy settings; a missing field means hidden or not set

items.name: getChat
items.use: ChatFullInfo of the private chat: the fields below

items.name: ChatFullInfo.bio
items.use: rarely needed by a service

items.name: ChatFullInfo.birthdate
items.use: a birthday greeting or an age gate the user expects; the year is often absent

items.name: ChatFullInfo.personal_chat
items.use: the channel the user shows on the profile

items.name: ChatFullInfo.photo
items.use: the current avatar

items.name: ChatFullInfo.emoji_status_custom_emoji_id
items.use: showing the status the user chose

items.name: ChatFullInfo.rating
items.use: the user's Stars rating level, a trust signal for digital purchases

items.name: ChatFullInfo.ton_wallet_card
items.use: shown to everyone on the profile; never treat it as proof of ownership

items.name: ChatFullInfo.accepted_gift_types
items.use: whether a gift can be sent

items.name: ChatFullInfo.business_location
items.use: a business account's public address

items.name: getUserProfilePhotos
items.use: profile pictures, up to 100

items.name: getUserProfileAudios
items.use: audios on the profile

items.name: getUserGifts
items.use: gifts shown on the profile

items.name: getUserPersonalChatMessages
items.use: the last posts of the user's personal channel (1-20)

items.name: getChatMember
items.use: the user's status in a chat; guaranteed only where the bot is an administrator

items.name: getUserChatBoosts
items.use: boosts the user gave a chat the bot administers

items.name: ChatFullInfo.active_usernames
items.use: every active username, collectible ones included

items.name: ChatFullInfo.has_private_forwards
items.use: tg://user?id links work only in chats with the user: mention by username

items.name: ChatFullInfo.has_restricted_voice_and_video_messages
items.use: do not send voice or video notes

items.name: ChatFullInfo.share_theme
items.use: the personal accent on the user's own surfaces (user-profile.md section 3)

items.name: ChatFullInfo.unique_gift_colors
items.use: gift-based name colours for light and dark

items.name: ChatFullInfo.community
items.use: the community a managed chat belongs to

items.name: ChatMemberMember.tag
items.use: a member's tag in a chat the bot manages

on_request.what: only after the user taps a native prompt or sends it; each needs a visible reason and works when refused

items.name: KeyboardButton.request_contact
items.use: the user's phone number as a Contact message, private chats only

items.name: WebApp.requestContact
items.use: the same from a Mini App (6.9): the bot receives the Contact, the app only learns sent or cancelled

items.name: Contact.phone_number
items.use: check Contact.user_id equals the sender, else it is someone else's card

items.name: Contact.user_id
items.use: proof the shared number is the sender's own

items.name: KeyboardButton.request_location
items.use: one location message, private chats only

items.name: WebApp.LocationManager
items.use: location inside a Mini App (8.0) after the user allows it

items.name: Location.horizontal_accuracy
items.use: how exact the point is; round before storing

items.name: KeyboardButtonRequestUsers.request_name
items.use: names of users the user chooses to share; they did not consent

items.name: SharedUser.username
items.use: only what the bot asked for and the user shared

items.name: KeyboardButtonRequestChat.request_title
items.use: a chat the user picks, e.g. to connect the bot

items.name: WebApp.requestWriteAccess
items.use: permission to message the user (6.9)

items.name: WebApp.requestEmojiStatusAccess
items.use: permission to set the user's emoji status (8.0)

items.name: sendInvoice.need_phone_number
items.use: phone for a physical order paid with a provider; ignored for Stars

items.name: sendInvoice.need_shipping_address
items.use: address for delivery; ignored for Stars

items.name: OrderInfo.email
items.use: a receipt for a provider payment

items.name: PassportData
items.use: Telegram Passport documents, encrypted to the bot's key, for regulated identity checks only

items.name: WebApp.sendData
items.use: what the user submits in a keyboard-launched Mini App, up to 4096 bytes

items.name: Location.live_period
items.use: a live location the user shares while a courier comes; stop using it when the order ends

items.name: InlineQuery.location
items.use: nearby inline results, only after location requests are enabled (BotFather or setMySettings needs_inline_query_location)

items.name: EncryptedPassportElement.phone_number
items.use: a phone number Telegram verified, through Telegram Passport

items.name: EncryptedPassportElement.email
items.use: an email Telegram verified, through Telegram Passport

items.name: WebApp.BiometricManager
items.use: device-local step-up; biometrics never leave the phone, the server sees only your token

never.what: not available to bots, and the skill does not build a way around it
items: another user's phone number, unless that user shares it themselves
the user's contact list, other chats, message history outside chats with the bot
location without a prompt the user accepted
the IP address of bot users (a Mini App's server sees the IP of its own requests: treat it as personal data)
data from outside Telegram joined to the Telegram profile (search engines, leaks, data brokers, other platforms)
